en.title: Odd One Out
en.description:
Given a sequence of uppercase words of equal length. For each word, compute the sequence of signed differences between adjacent letters; return the word whose difference sequence differs from all the others. Exactly n−1 words are guaranteed to share the same difference sequence, and the remaining one is different.

This site uses a standard input/output protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n, followed by n lines of words. 3≤n≤26, 2≤word length≤26; the words in a test all have the same length and contain only uppercase English letters.
en.output: Output the one word that is different.
en.explanation: Compare the directed sequences of adjacent-letter differences. For example, ACB and BDC are both (+2,−1).
hints: Compare the directed sequences of adjacent-letter differences. For example, ACB and BDC are both (+2,−1).
